caption:
Stock market news | Rupee snaps 5-day rally, settles at 92.92

The Indian rupee ended the session at 92.92 against the US dollar, ending a five-day rally. It touched a low of 93.11 before closing down 30 paise.
Lower crude oil prices and a weakening US dollar failed to buoy the rupee, as global stock market volatility added pressure.
